tool_args.rationale: Short-horizon observations support positive gain but do not distinguish the stated dual-horizon adaptation law from other mechanisms at H=20. The designated slow-horizon probe is needed to test the predicted reversal before authoring and confirming a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing observations all have H≤0.48, so they cannot identify the slow adaptation term or verify the predicted long-horizon reversal at target H=20.

This is indicated for fitting the 4-parameter coupled-memory ODE, but the stated candidate mechanism is the 5-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law and its designated discriminator is the slow-horizon probe.
It does not resolve the horizon ambiguity and is explicitly irrelevant.
